attr.title: Monument Valley
attr.desc: Guide Ida through impossible architecture. Android ARM64 port for RG35XX-H/KNULLI with native gamepad input and landscape/TATE layouts.
attr.inst: Copy your Monument Valley 3.10.114 ARM64 APK as monument-valley-3.10.114.apk into ports/monumentvalley and launch Monument Valley. Setup is automatic. Required SHA-256: 6a786c9cc65a196abb45e29dd01c400dfcf547d42fe004e3b084f235ac5fa301.
attr.inst_md:
1. Download [monumentvalley.zip](https://github.com/elarkitechto/rg35xxh-ports/releases/download/monumentvalley-v0.1.4/monumentvalley.zip) and extract it into **Ports**.
2. Rename the compatible APK to **monument-valley-3.10.114.apk** and copy it into **ports/monumentvalley/**.
3. Open **Monument Valley** from Ports. First-run conversion is automatic; no compiler or separate setup launcher is needed. Keep the APK in that folder.

**Required APK SHA-256:**
```text
6a786c9cc65a196abb45e29dd01c400dfcf547d42fe004e3b084f235ac5fa301
```

The exact hash is required: the compatibility profile targets this ARM64 build.
Other repacks, Netflix editions and Windows/Panoramic files are unsupported.
This is the Android game with its original landscape layout, not the PC edition.
